data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net prior year strengthening of GBP 4.2m for the 2017 calendar year, representing 4.81% of opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by unfavourable development in Property, Political Risks, and European Creditor business. Specific contributing factors included a legacy claim and two large claims in the Non-Marine Liability account, as well as large claims in prior periods for Political Risks. The 2016 year of account also experienced material adverse claims development in Property and Political Risks, with Q3 2017 catastrophes impacting the Property account and large claims affecting Political Risks.
